title: PRD-14 synthetic risk input syntax

participantRefs.description: required; 1–100 authorized refs; larger rosters use bulk. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: PARTICIPANT_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

sportCode.description: required; carrier/issuer classification <= 60. Sensitivity: internal. Error: SPORT_UNMAPPED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

activityLevelCode.description: required; offered recreational/competition classification. Sensitivity: internal. Error: ACTIVITY_LEVEL_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

eventRef.description: optional; authorized event/organizer reference. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: EVENT_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

periodStart.description: required; explicit activity-local date. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PERIOD_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

periodEnd.description: required; not before start. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: PERIOD_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

issuerPlanCode.description: required; authorized issuer plan/version. Sensitivity: internal. Error: ISSUER_NOT_AUTHORIZED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
